messages: Ivy (People Ops): Quick update  we've clarified the offboarding section in the handbook (data access revocation timing + equipment return windows). Please review and have impacted teams ack by EOD next Thursday. Link: https://hub.example.com/handbook/offboarding-clarity. :mag_right:; Claire (Manager): Thanks Ivy. Can you confirm who needs to ACK? Is it just managers or every employee?; Ivy (People Ops): All full-time employees + contractors with org access must confirm the offboarding ack. Managers should bulk upload team rows for faster tracking.; Rohan (HRBP): We'll mark alumni-facing roles (talent, finance, security) as HIGH_PRIORITY for revocation timelines. Those folks require access removal within 2 hours of separation; others have 24h. We'll add a column for deprovision_priority in the CSV.; Ben (Security): Reminder: for HIGH_PRIORITY folks, also trigger immediate key rotation for shared service accounts they used. We'll provide a per-user checklist to attach to HR tickets.; Claire (Manager): Can you paste the CSV header so I can prep my team?; Ivy (People Ops): Sure  header: manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,deprovision_priority,equipment_return_by,acknowledged_at; Ivy (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,deprovision_priority,equipment_return_by,acknowledged_at```; Ben (Security): If a departing contractor is extended for 2 weeks, do we treat them as active or in-transition for access?; Rohan (HRBP): Treat as active until their new end_date; HR will file an extension ticket and Security will adjust access TTLs accordingly. Put extension notes in the notes column.; Claire (Manager): What if someone refuses to sign the ack? Is there a formal escalation?; Ivy (People Ops): Escalate to HRBP (Rohan) and cc Security if the role touches sensitive systems. We'll log the refusal and schedule a 1:1. Persistent refusal triggers policy review with Legal.; ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Offboarding handbook ack" will post T-72h and T-24h before deadline.; Claire (Manager): Uploaded CSV and flagged two contractors as "HIGH_PRIORITY" due to infra creds. ; Ben (Security): Got the flag. I'll queue key rotation and notify infra owners. ; Rohan (HRBP): I'll follow up on any blockers and coordinate exceptions. Managers: final checklist - 1) bulk upload your CSV, 2) confirm e-sign invites sent, 3) track equipment return windows. Ivy will export completion stats after the window: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/offboarding_ack_1956.csv ./offboarding_ack_1956.csv```; Ivy (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll post a short manager script and canned Slack reminder in #people-ops shortly. :white_check_mark:
